# Fonts

Self-hosted web fonts, so the page doesn't wait on Google Fonts.

## What's here

- `DRAFTPAPER/`: display face, used for the hero text
- `IBMPlexSans/`: body face, latin subset, weight 300 and italic

## How it connects

- Declared in [styles/typography/imports.css](../../styles/typography/imports.css).
- The display font is preloaded from `fonts.njk`.
